intended_object: An auxiliary fresh variable used as a bound "dummy" variable in an alpha-renaming step of a machine-generated nominal proof certificate (upstream name `nb095_alpha_dummy_746`). I inferred this from the docstring, the name and the body.
explanation: The body returns `freshVar (...).fv 1`. This is a variable chosen to avoid the free variables of a particular syntactic class term, and that term is itself built from other dummy variables (`nb095AlphaDummy742`, `nb095AlphaDummy740`, `nb095AlphaDummy006`). The definition is bookkeeping inside a generated proof certificate, used to support alpha-conversion. It is an implementation detail with no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so it cannot be judged as faithful or unfaithful to any object.
